Bank mock fixtures for DDS import tests.

The JSON files are intentionally synthetic and self-documenting. They cover:

- Sber acquiring inflow.
- Sber outflow to the own T-Bank account.
- T-Bank inflow from the own Sber account.
- T-Bank acquiring inflow with the seed rule phrase.
- T-Bank supplier outflow.
- T-Bank outflow with "Налог НДФЛ" in the purpose.
- Unknown operations that should become owner-review cases.
